SculptGL — https://github.com/stephaneginier/sculptgl
Author: Stéphane Ginier. License: MIT (see the repository for the full license text).
This folder contains the unmodified production build (sculptgl.js) and resources from https://stephaneginier.com/sculptgl/,
plus a small bridge in index.html for PS1 Viewer (analytics and Sketchfab login removed).
